risky_clauses.title: Irrevocable 5-Year Lock-In with 5-Day Notice Window
risky_clauses.summary: Automatic 5-year renewal unless notice given in an exact 5-day window (180 to 175 days before expiry), plus 35% fee surcharge upon auto-renewal.

risky_clauses.title: Waiver of All Warranties & Gross Negligence Claims
risky_clauses.summary: Client forfeits all legal action and damages even for bodily injury or patient record loss caused by Vendor's gross negligence or willful misconduct.

obligations: Vendor provides 24x7 automated robotic dispatch and maintenance
Vendor provides emergency response within 2 hours
Both parties must safeguard confidential proprietary information
Client must submit disputes to binding arbitration in Fremont, CA
reply_email_rubric: Rejects 5-year auto-renewal and 5-day notice window trap in Section 3.1
Demands standard 30-day notice for 1-year renewals without 35% surcharge
Rejects total waiver of gross negligence and bodily injury claims in Section 4.1
Professional commercial tone with healthcare regulatory compliance requirements
